'''Claude Birraux''' (born 18 January 1946 in [[Ambilly]], [[Haute-Savoie]]) is a member of the [[National Assembly of France]].<ref name='anfr'>{{Cite web |url=http://www.assemblee-nationale.fr/13/tribun/fiches_id/525.asp |title=Claude Birraux |author=Office of the Secretary General |language=French |year=2012 |publisher=[[National Assembly of France]] |work=Assemblee-nationale.fr |accessdate=2 March 2012 }}</ref>  He represents the [[Haute-Savoie]] department, and is a member of the [[Union for a Popular Movement]].<ref name='anfr'/>
